### 📓 Docs Drift Check
⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/connectors/connector-openapi/tsconfig.scripts.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files. Nothing else in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)).

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/connectors/connector-openapi/tsconfig.scripts.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **2** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3bfb357aa37e043420bcd08ab45d5a7f5335cb86` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## 席位核对

**ACCEPT** at head `f9a4f408` · `Implemented-by:` `claude/issue-27373-openapi-normalize` · `Reviewed-by:` this seat. No contract-review record is owed: `Clause-②: no`, no `packages/spec/src/**` path, no governed path (`check-governed-merges --pr 27436`: NOT governed), so CI plus this seat's read is the review.

| Check | Result |
|:--|:--|
| Shape | draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #27373`; the only closing keyword |
| Scope | 9 files, +1228/−1; runtime `src/` untouched; the script is outside `files` (`dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`), so nothing published changes and `skip-changeset` is right. Surface addendum: `tsconfig.scripts.json` (without it no `tsc` program reads `scripts/**`; precedent `packages/spec/tsconfig.scripts.json`) |
| Dependencies | `@scalar/openapi-upgrader` 0.4.6 and `@scalar/json-magic` 0.17.0, both **devDependencies**, both MIT, both latest published 2026-10-23 — re-read from `registry.npmjs.org` by this seat, matching the PR's table. Lockfile regenerated with `pnpm install --lockfile-only` (+38 lines, no unrelated peer flip) |
| Gates | 71 check-runs on the head: 59 success, 12 skipped (all on main's roster, `check-expected-skips` OK); mergeable `clean` |
| Evidence | 13 script tests, each loading its output through the real `createOpenApiProviderFactory` with no `$ref`; the real Stripe (612 actions) and DocuSign (414 actions) documents normalized once locally with the sha256 matching `sha256sum` |
| Docs, checked line by line | `connectors.mdx`: "not shipped in the npm package" (true by `files`), the CLI flags (`--in`, `--out`, `--include-pattern`, `--max-depth` default 2, `--empty-consumes`) as the script defines them, and "the runtime never converts" (unchanged) |

**The dev's three open questions, decided by the seat** (implementation parameters, inside triage's ruling 6487372008; no product or contract fork):
1. Reachability — **A**: stays a repo script, as triage ruled. The cloud shelf pipeline runs it from an `objectstack` checkout; whether it can is the cloud side's fact, carried by E4's pipeline card (#27302's ruling files it in the cloud repository).
2. Inlining depth — **A**: default `--max-depth 2`, a stub naming each replaced reference; `--include-pattern` keeps real shelf documents small.
3. Empty `consumes` — **A**: refused by default, named per operation; `--empty-consumes` is the explicit opt-in. A guessed media type is the silent-wrong class the script exists to remove.

**Out of scope:** `filed #27463` (path-item `parameters` never read by the generator, class a) · `Acceptance notes`: `discriminator.mapping` names dropped components (dormant), the upgrader's `produces` precedence (upstream, no effect on either real document).

**Landing:** not governed: the seat lands it now (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`).
